firmware.note: v0.1.10 (built 2026-11-24): setup network on EVERY power-on — a 5-minute WaltQuotes-Setup window opens before the normal wake on any power-on boot (timer wakes, Reset presses and OTA reboots do not open it), extending while a phone is connected (1-hour hard cap). Replaces the power-flip x3 gesture, whose counter any successful WiFi join zeroed — unreachable within range of the panel's own network. The 15-minute window still serves the never-configured and failed-wakes triggers. Everything else is exactly v0.1.9. The firmware channel reads only version + url; sha256/sizeBytes recorded for verification.
